:::{#sol-null-space-subspace-practice}

Move every term to the left side:
$x_1 + x_2 - x_3 = 0$ and $x_2 - 2 x_3 = 0$.
With

$$
\matr{A} = \sbmat{1 & 1 & -1 \\ 0 & 1 & -2},
$$

the two equations say $\matr{A}\vecf{x} = \vzero_2$,
so $\mathcal{S} = \mathcal{N}(\matr{A})$.
By @thm-null-space-subspace, $\mathcal{S}$ is a [subspace](linear-algebra-subspaces.qmd#def-subspace) of $\reals^3$.

:::
